scope: Contribution 1 known-only baseline optimization and budget tuning

stage_1_centralized_screen.description: Screen a small learning-rate and training-window grid using centralized CLOSR first.
ranking_rule: maximize six-seed mean known-selection closed-set Macro-F1
for candidates within 0.005 Macro-F1, maximize the lower of mean Normal recall and mean Sybil recall
if still tied, minimize mean Normal-to-Sybil error rate
if still tied, choose fewer optimizer steps through the selected checkpoint

stage_2_three_way_confirmation.description: Freeze the centralized winner, then apply its learning rate unchanged to centralized, IID FedAvg, and natural Non-IID FedAvg CLOSR.
stage_2_three_way_confirmation.federated_optimizer_state: fresh AdamW per client per round, unchanged from the baseline
stage_2_three_way_confirmation.round_budget_rule: Use 30 rounds to isolate the selected learning rate. If and only if the centralized winner is a longer-window candidate, also run one predeclared 60-round confirmation for both FedAvg modes.
within_seed_controls: identical initial model tensors across all three configurations
fixed source partitions, known-selection group, known-calibration group, and IID repartition
reproducibly controlled but composition-dependent sampler streams
same CLOSR architecture, original CLOSR loss, class centers, scoring, and strict rejection rule

interpretation.shared_baseline_weakness: Centralized and IID improve consistently under the frozen winner; improvement in natural is assessed separately.
interpretation.additional_federated_weakness: Centralized improves but IID does not, indicating that centralized tuning alone does not transfer to FedAvg optimization.
interpretation.additional_natural_partition_associated_: Centralized and IID improve while paired natural-minus-IID development gaps persist across seeds. This is association under the controls, not a causal Non-IID claim.
interpretation.screen_does_not_help: If centralized CLOSR does not improve, stop this tuning branch and reassess the known-class baseline without automatically changing the CLOSR method.

fixed_invariants: original class-specific CLOSR loss and normalization
known-only training, checkpoint selection, center computation, and calibration
forbidden_during_tuning: rejection-threshold tuning as a known-confusion remedy
distillation, adaptation, another detector, or method changes

after_development.protocol_freeze: Freeze the chosen configuration, code revision, dependency lock, seeds, partition and manifest hashes, selection rule, calibration rule, output schema, and one-shot evaluation command before opening performance data from the final test.
after_development.unknown_evaluation: After the freeze, run the declared source-disjoint final-test evaluation once. Calibrate thresholds only from the frozen known-calibration group; report known metrics and Wormhole unknown metrics without retuning.
